_comment: World calendar and in-game clock. Saved changes apply within a few seconds. With enabled=false the server uses real time, a 5s-per-UO-minute clock and the season windows below are ignored in favour of the built-in December/October windows.
_calendar_mode_help: real = server clock; offset = server clock + offset_days/offset_hours; fixed = always fixed_date (yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss).

game_clock._help: seconds_per_uo_minute: real seconds per in-game minute (default 5). Changing it or 'frozen' at runtime keeps the current in-game time. fixed_hour: -1 = off, 0-23 = force that hour.

seasons._help: Yearly MM-dd windows (inclusive). Windows may wrap the year end, e.g. 12-20..01-06. Systems query these by id.
